hero.description: I'm a frontend developer obsessed with Technical Humanism—the intersection of rigorous code and approachable, user-centric design.

about.subtitle: I am Hamza Bari, though colleagues often call me "Ice". I believe great interfaces emerge from the thoughtful marriage of engineering rigor and human empathy.
paragraphs: My path into frontend development wasn't just about learning syntax; it was about discovering the bridge between logical structures and human experience. It began with the foundational triad of HTML, CSS, and Tailwind, where I learned that structure and style are the silent narrators of any digital story.

As my curiosity deepened, I transitioned from static layouts to dynamic interaction. Mastering JavaScript DOM manipulation felt like gaining a superpower. My background in Python provided the algorithmic backbone, where manipulating variables and building logic became second nature.
about.philosophyQuote: Code should be as clean as a fresh design file, and design should be as structured as a well-written script.
